coordinateContract.rectangles: Source pixels; never assume equal grid slicing.
coordinateContract.anchor: Fractional ground contact within measured rectangle.
coordinateContract.logicalHeight: Requested height is scaled by logicalHeight when present, otherwise h.
coordinateContract.directions: North-up world: +x east, +y south. Action cycles face east and may mirror west unless direction says otherwise.
coordinateContract.units: Frame duration and display clock are milliseconds. Rigs use drawing-height-relative positions and turns/second.
coordinateContract.authority: Rendering never changes world state. No frame callbacks cause outcomes. Purge concealed actors; snap across time jumps. Buildings stay still.

gonzales.label: Gonzales
gonzales.note: Current schematic settlement. Cannon is illustrative, not an identification of a surviving gun.

alamo.label: Alamo, 1836
alamo.note: Roofless church shell without the later rounded facade. Assemble a researched compound; these are modular illustrations, not a measured plan.

san_antonio.label: San Antonio de Béxar
san_antonio.note: Courtyard houses, plazas and river geography. Generic church is not an exact cathedral portrait.

goliad.label: Goliad / La Bahía
goliad.note: Presidio compound and old settlement; no modern courthouse. Chapel and walls require site-specific arrangement.

liberty.label: Liberty
liberty.note: Timber river town and landing. River width and crossing behavior come from world data.

anahuac.label: Anahuac
anahuac.note: For September 1835 onward depict the disused ruined fort, not an operational cannon battery. Intact brick-bastion is for earlier researched context only.

san_felipe.label: San Felipe
san_felipe.note: Timber settlement. Ruin/fire requires an authorized event, never decorative default burning.

washington.label: Washington-on-the-Brazos
washington.note: Modest frame meeting place and river settlement. No monumental capitol.

san_jacinto.label: San Jacinto
san_jacinto.note: Prairie/marsh camps; no later monument. Reuse paired iron gun art symbolically for Twin Sisters; do not assert a disputed caliber.

evacuation.label: Runaway Scrape / road camps
evacuation.note: Reusable travel, aid and shelter kit; journeys, crowd knowledge and belongings remain persistent world state.

excludedFrames.reason: Generated later rounded facade. Never use for the 1836 Alamo; use roofless-church-shell instead.

sources.title: User-supplied San Antonio de Bexar 1836 panorama, George Nelson, GLO map 83600

bexar.note: Illustrated reconstruction from the supplied references. Streets, river course, building count, dimensions and plots are interpretive, not surveyed 1836 geography. Generic existing artwork stands in for named civic architecture. No historical household occupancy or battle state is inferred.

alamo.note: Schematic complete compound in real feet. Room partitions, door positions and props are reconstructed; dimensions are published approximations, not exact archaeological measurements.

codeArtwork.purpose: Prairie, relief, field polygons and fallbacks follow map geometry; not baked into atlases.

codeArtwork.type: canvas geometry with existing sprite accents
codeArtwork.animation: Static surface detail; water motion remains future work.
codeArtwork.purpose: Shared depth shading, bank detail, wheel ruts, shallow stone fords and explicit-site timber bridges. Never creates a crossing or changes travel geometry.
Thirty structures with work yards, paths, props and trees; illustrative scenery around the authoritative Gonzales site.
Parchment/wood/olive/rust panels, contextual card, family journal and responsive touch controls; no external font or UI image dependency.

remainingWork.delivered: Three body variants with separate spinning wheels in E/W; static damaged wagon, carts and limber.
remainingWork.remaining: N/S wagon/carts, articulated hitch/yoke and crew pushing/loading. Current oblique rig translates along any route without pretending to turn in 3D.

remainingWork.delivered: Four cast variants, cardinal walking, E/W work/carry/sow/repair/search/trade, care pair, rest/injury poses; Joe walk/hide/emerge/speak/rest; mounted courier listening/speaking/letter offer/pointing.
remainingWork.remaining: N/S work/dialogue action poses, turns, climbing, swimming, assisted walking/stretcher pairs, individual civilian riding/dismounting and final mounted cross-sheet registration. Dedicated mounted courier and dragoon travel already exist.

remainingWork.delivered: Two casts of four and four children: rust and rust-woman reserved for the principal, teal and indigo, elder and ochre, blue and blue-girl, each with cardinal walking, work, carry, care, search, trade, sowing, repair, rest and injury; a girl, a boy, a small child and an infant; speaking and listening poses for both casts, drawn since 2026-09-21; mounted courier listening and speaking, and the same north and south. All eight identities ride the chestnut horse east (west mirrored), south and north as one painted frame, and the four original-cast identities drive the ox wagon in all four headings as a seated layer over it - both drawn since 2026-09-21 (public/motion.js seatedClip/seatLayout).
remainingWork.remaining: The rider dismounting, remounting and talking on foot beside a tethered horse (courier-dismount is delivered and not yet bound); seated ox-wagon driver layers for the second cast (rust-woman, indigo, ochre, blue-girl) and for the children, who are still the standing figure cut at the hip; a child on the family horse, which is still that same composite; layered people for the chosen looks.

remainingWork.delivered: Ox/chestnut horse/cow/pig cardinal walking and four-pose grazing; white-tailed deer idle, alert, bound and drinking cycles; eastern wild turkey forage, alert, bound and wing-display cycles; wild mustang graze, alert and eight-beat gallop, the graze and alert drawn in a hunt since 2026-09-21; alternate animals have idle breathing only.
remainingWork.remaining: The rest of the game of 1836 (bear, javelina, antelope, buffalo, geese, wild cattle), which is words only until each lands; cream ox/grey horse/sheep/chicken locomotion, other livestock grazing and drinking, flight and load/harness behavior. Do not substitute a different coat mid-journey.

remainingWork.delivered: Cardinal iron gun poses, E/W iron/bronze carriage recoil, smoke, volunteer/regular aim-fire-load-ramrod and surrender, mounted marching, plus volunteer/regular ramming, roundshot carrying, lanyard and cover-ear service poses.
remainingWork.remaining: Limber/unlimber, elevated aim, mounted firing and remounting. Gun recoil is whole-carriage translation, not an articulated barrel rig.

remainingWork.delivered: Modular intact/ruined/breached pieces, Alamo door/chest opening pairs and collapse sequence; ground-anchor wind and separate effects.
remainingWork.remaining: Continuous door/gate hinge rig, construction/repair progression, crown-only tree rig, boat rowing/poling and ferry loading. The Yellow Stone under way landed 2026-09-21: the army-laden loop is drawn at the Brazos crossing, and the empty-deck loop is registered and drawn by nothing, because no projected state has her steaming light. Building stillness is intentional; condition changes require simulation state.

remainingWork.delivered: Measured alpha frames and per-row logical heights for stable cycle scale.
remainingWork.remaining: Generated pose proportions can drift between sheets. Hand-register additional transitions and final cast/period uniform variants as the game defines them. These are prototype assets, not exact historical portraits.
